press_key.mechanism: native keystrokes (CDP Input.dispatchKeyEvent on shared tabs, CDP keyboard on managed profiles); named keys only — type text with browser.type

set_viewport.windowScope: scope 'window' (real Chrome window resize) is shared-tab only and reports the affected window, its other tabs and retained original bounds; managed profiles support scope 'tab' emulation only

set_zoom.mechanism: real Chrome zoom via chrome.tabs.setZoom with per-tab zoom settings (original factor and settings preserved for reset); managed profiles have no browser-zoom surface and CSS zoom/transforms/device-scale are never substituted
